_comment: Zenodo deposit metadata for the ges-uves-mk-audit code-and-data archive. Upload via the Zenodo web UI at https://zenodo.org/deposit/new or programmatically via the Zenodo REST API. Two placeholders to fill at upload time: arXiv id (after manuscript posts) and the GitHub release commit hash (after a release tag is pushed). The 'doi' field is auto-assigned by Zenodo at deposit time and should NOT be set here.

metadata.title: ges-uves-mk-audit: interventional masked-line ablation audit of a tree-based MK classifier on Gaia-ESO UVES spectra (code, trained model, and feature matrix)
metadata.description:
This deposit accompanies the manuscript of the same name and contains: (1) the trained LightGBM MK classifier (lgbm_mk.pkl, 1.77 MB), (2) the engineered feature matrix and labels (features.npz, with X, y, wave_centers, train/val/test indices, gap_mask, ra_deg, dec_deg, median_imputer, and metadata; about 7 MB compressed), (3) the full set of analysis artifacts (ablation, interpretability, sensitivity, and benchmark JSON/CSV/NPZ files), and (4) the manuscript numerical-claims dossier (manuscript_numbers.csv and .md) mapping every numeric value in the paper to its source artifact.

The audit applies interventional masked-line ablation to a tree-based stellar classifier of Gaia-ESO Survey FLAMES-UVES U580 spectra in the 4800 to 6800 Angstrom window. Headline finding: two of three pre-specified (line set, class) pairs reject the random-window null at p < 0.002; the K-class null on the Mg b triplet, corroborated by null results on Na D and Ca I, is interpreted as a multi-leg shortcut combining an inherited continuum-level signal with Fe I and Cr I multiplet substitution in place of the canonical neutral-metal diagnostics.

Underlying spectra are public via the ESO Science Archive Facility under Gaia-ESO Programme 188.B-3002. Recommended stellar parameters are from Hourihane et al. 2023 (A&A 676, A129; bibcode 2023A&A...676A.129H). The Pickles 1998 UVKLIB stellar flux library used for the external benchmark is public via the STScI HLSP reference-atlases mirror. This deposit redistributes only the feature matrix derived from the Gaia-ESO spectra, not the raw spectra themselves; users seeking raw spectra should fetch from the ESO Science Archive directly. Please cite the Gaia-ESO Survey (Gilmore et al. 2022, A&A 666, A120; Sacco et al. 2014, A&A 565, A113) alongside this deposit when using the feature matrix.

files_to_attach.description: Trained LightGBM model binary (sklearn pickle; load via src/interpret/classifier.load_model)
Engineered feature matrix and labels: X (n=3032 spectra, 696 bins), y (FGK), wave_centers, train/val/test indices, gap_mask, ra_deg/dec_deg for spatial CV, median_imputer fit on training rows only
Held-out test metrics, StratifiedKFold and StratifiedGroupKFold CV summaries, and boundary-filtered sensitivity
Numerical-claims dossier mapping every paper number to its source artifact path and field
Masked-line ablation result family: headline gate evaluation, TOST equivalence, paired bootstrap, flip-rate decomposition, Mg b EW per-class measurements, line-match sweep
Permutation importance, TreeSHAP, and sliding-window occlusion outputs plus the three-way triangulation report
Independent-continuum re-derivation, uniform-weights retrain, 3x3 hyperparameter grid, polynomial-continuum appendix diagnostics
